Description: Years from a stand-replacing disturbance until NLCD shows forest (P26 burns: median 21 years). A regrowing cell starts at this minus the years until NLCD first shows it as forest; a cell first forest this many years or more after the start keeps its CMS or TreeMap age (more likely an open stand filling in)
Share of the years from that first forest year to the end of the record the cell must be forest in; cells that flicker between forest and shrub or grass keep their CMS or TreeMap age
Years at the start of the record the cell must not be forest in
